core.title: Solid Brass Regal Contemporary Door Knocker

text.description_html:
Omnia Regal Contemporary Door Knocker.

The Regal door knocker is both Contemporary and Elegant, making it the perfect center piece for many home styles.

Omnia's Door Knockers add those details, those distinctive touches which claify and reinforce fine architecture and design. Their dedication to detail is revealed in the latest selection of solid brass door knockers.

After hand poishing and high buffing, a hard and transparent lacquer is baked onto each piece. This special process retains the tradition of old world excellence while employing the best available modern technology to protect and preserve your fine taste.

The Omnia Max-Brass finish will change the way you think about finishes. The unique process in the manufacturing provides a superior resistance to tarnish or potting.

Available in 2 different sizes.

OMN-600/100

  • Overall Size: 5"
  • Center to center: 3-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"

OMN-600/125

  • Overall Size: 6"
  • Center to center: 4"
  • Projection: 2"

Available in 2 different Finishes.
US3 Polished Brass
MB Max Brass
Max Brass is a PVD polished brass coating that is highly resistant to extreme elements. It has a lifetime No Tarnish Guarantee. Recommended for harsh environments such as salty air.
